scope.catalog_source: NASA Five Millennium Catalogs; complete century pages1801-1900,1901-2000,2001-2100 filtered to fixed scope
scope.preserved_input: eclipses.csv remains selected historical context, byte-for-byte unchanged
scope.interpretation: Astronomical predictions, including past modeled events; not a human sighting census or an outcome-driven event selection. No causal or prophetic-fulfillment inference.

location.label: Jerusalem representative point; not an all-Israel visibility footprint
location.coordinate_definition: NASA city entry31deg46min00secN35deg14min00secE808.9m; longitude passed west-negative to NASA code

calculation.algorithm: Unmodified NASA JSEX and JLEX program.js plus official century element arrays, separately versioned and hash-pinned
calculation.solar_visibility: NASA JSEX getall local event type>0 after horizon clipping. Source Sun altitude threshold -0.00524radians; source sunrise/sunset clipping retained, described by NASA as lower-limb horizon contact. Separate global type, local type, maximum altitude/magnitude/obscuration, full contact interval and horizon-visible interval.
calculation.lunar_visibility: At least one positive-duration part of a phase satisfies NASA JLEX visibility flag0, with source parallax and threshold Moon semidiameter minus0.5667degrees. Retain penumbral/umbral/total durations separately, plus above-horizon duration for each phase. Penumbral geometry does not promise naked-eye detectability.
calculation.lunar_duration_solver: Evaluate unmodified populatecircumstances on60second brackets; bisect visibility transitions to0.1second. Retain all contacts, including below-horizon ones; never turn absent umbral/total phases into measured zeros.
calculation.reported_altitude: Degrees from NASA source algorithms. JLEX clamps small negative visible altitudes to0; record that convention rather than claiming unmodified geometric altitude.
calculation.environment: Source idealized horizon/refraction conventions only. No terrain, buildings, clouds, atmospheric extinction, twilight contrast or all-Israel spatial footprint. Lunar source altitude input does not enter its simplified altitude calculation; no elevation precision claim.
calculation.future_uncertainty: Use original source ephemeris and delta-T model; do not silently replace with modern estimates. Future rotation uncertainty can shift circumstances. Node/source revision is recorded.

time.contact_time_scale: Modeled Universal Time (UT1): source TD minus source delta-T. Explicit UT1 fields without a false exact-UTC label; not leap-second-aware UTC.
time.midnight: Each contact gets its own full Gregorian date. Source lunar display date is P1; catalog identity date is greatest TD. Keep both without merging dates.
time.rounding: Use underlying contact offsets without NASA display rounding (+0.5second solar/+30seconds lunar). Serialize modeled contact seconds; report source precision and validation limits.

validation.selection: Fixed technical cases before computed local outcomes. One published2006Jerusalem solar table was inspected during source discovery; no computed Jerusalem time series examined before freeze.
validation.catalog_checks: Strict global identity/type/count coverage, including1900and2100boundaries; unique joins; source catalog vs element identity cross-check. All global events retained even if locally invisible.
validation.local_validation_limit: Published NASA solar local table is an independent published implementation cross-check, not independent physics. Lunar published contact tables/maps check phase times and geographic visibility; source display replay only checks wrapper fidelity. State separate coverage/limitations.
validation.failure: A discrepancy blocks trusted status and snapshot promotion pending explicit source/version explanation. Do not widen frozen tolerance in response to results.

provenance.raw: Versioned original bytes, source URLs, fetch timestamps, SHA256 hashes and source headers/attribution; immutable prior revisions retained
provenance.offline: Complete offline replay from pinned raw inputs; live fetch staged and fully validated before promotion
provenance.code: Preserve NASA GPLv2-or-later notices and license in vendor subtree; retain catalog attribution. No code/source update silently becomes trusted.
provenance.artifacts: Separate global catalog, local event/contact tables, annual model counts, validation report and monitor metadata; original curated CSV never substituted
